newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up on blue chips, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up on blue chips, seen rising.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed higher on Friday, bolstered by speculative buying in blue chips, and dealers said the index looked set to gain further.
"Blue chip Hub Power and telecom utility PTCL continue to remain in demand," dealer Sajad Mankani said.
The index rose 6.91 points, or 0.42 percent, to end at 1,655.76. Gainers beat losers 136 to 104. Hub Power rose 0.65 rupees to 44.30 and East West Insurance 3.0 to 184.
